mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name AS realName, phone, status, pwd_update_time AS pwdUpdateTime FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, real_name AS realName, phone, status, pwd_update_time AS pwdUpdateTime FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, pwd_update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, pwd_update_time = NOW() WHERE username = 'admin' AND is_deleted = 0 AND pwd_update_time = '1970-01-01 00:00:00'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_login_log (user_id, username, login_type, result, fail_reason, ip, login_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{loginType}, #{result}, #{failReason}, #{ip}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id AND rp.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0
SELECT rt.tunnel_id FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_tunnel rt ON rt.role_id = ur.role_id AND rt.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0
SELECT MIN(r.data_scope) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0
